svg.title: Подъём носков сидя с блином — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated weighted toe raise for tibialis. Side three-quarter view. Seated on bench, heels planted on floor under knees and forefeet together. A SINGLE round weight disc with center hole lies horizontally on TOP of the forefeet, visible as an elliptical disc spanning both shoe fronts. START both forefeet down, FINISH toes lift with disc while heels remain on floor; disc tilts up visibly along with shoe fronts. Hands may reach down to steady plate, not lift it. No plate on knees, no calf raise. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
